pools.name: Parliament Hill Lido
notes: Unheated 61 m lido, open all year. Winter hours: last entry 1pm, out of the water by 1:30pm.
Tickets on the City of London's booking site or at the gate.

pools.name: Kenwood Ladies' Pond
notes: Natural bathing pond for women, open all year; the times run until everyone has to be out of the water (last entry 15 minutes earlier).
Unheated: in winter the water is often below 5 °C.

pools.name: Highgate Men's Pond
notes: Natural bathing pond for men, open all year; the times run until everyone has to be out of the water (last entry 15 minutes earlier).
Unheated: in winter the water is often below 5 °C.

pools.name: Hampton Pool
notes: Heated 36 m outdoor pool, open every day of the year. Lane swim: the main pool in six lanes. Recreational swim: three lanes, the other half for play.
The weekly times on the pool's home page; the weekend column isn't labelled there, so check before you go. Book in the pool's app.

pools.name: Sea Lanes Canary Wharf
notes: Unheated 50 m natural floating pool with six lanes in Eden Dock, open all year, and open water dock swimming. The weekly times from the pool's page; book a swim online (public bookings open a week ahead).

pools.name: Tooting Bec Lido
pools.closed: Open to the public in summer (late May to September). In winter only members of the South London Swimming Club swim here.
notes: Unheated 91 m lido, the largest freshwater pool in England.
